human_substantive_critiques.issue: Unadjusted multiple hypothesis testing across the six bacterial phyla tested in multivariable binary logistic regression (Firmicutes nominal p = 0.045).
Binary visual read of amyloid PET has ~88% sensitivity/specificity and requires cross-validation against quantitative regional SUVR.
Lack of genus-level taxonomic regression analyses and alpha/beta diversity comparisons between amyloid-positive and amyloid-negative groups.
Missing statistical comparisons across baseline demographic and cognitive characteristics (CDR >= 0.5, MMSE, education) in Table 1.
Missing public sequence repository deposition for raw 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing data.

ai_only_critical_catches: Arbitrary median dichotomization of compositional 16S microbiome relative abundances ('above-median' vs. 'below-median') instead of standard compositional microbiome regression methods (CLR transformation, ANCOM-BC, ALDEx2, or MaAsLin2).

Omission of statistically significant measured confounders (education years, p = 0.006) and key unmeasured confounders (APOE e4 genotype, BMI, diet) from the multivariable logistic regression model, plus failure to report the number of participants with recent antibiotic use in Table 1.
Internal degrees-of-freedom error in the Shannon Index equal-variance Student's t-test (df = 125 reported for N = 136 total participants, where equal-variance df must be n1 + n2 - 2 = 134).
Opposite-direction nominal genus-level associations within Firmicutes (Clostridium OR = 2.34 vs. Dorea OR = 0.47) that contradict the claim of a coherent phylum-wide effect.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Mendelian inheritance expectations for presence-absence variation (PAV) genes and potential structural/recombination mechanisms driving deviations from Mendelian ratios in F1 progeny needed formal explanation.

Genomic context and transposable element enrichment flanking PAV loci, as well as evolutionary mechanisms generating PAVs (tandem duplication, horizontal viral integration), required analysis and discussion.

Two reference gonad samples in Branchiostoma belcheri skewed the coverage-vs.-dispensable-gene correlation in Fig 1b, and BelcheriHV-1 SNP frequency/read-depth plots (Fig 3b-d) needed clearer biological explanation.
Bioinformatics pipeline and figure-generation scripts were not deposited in a public code repository.

ai_only_critical_catches: Systematic downward bias in observed F1 offspring gene absence rates relative to Mendelian expectations (39.6% vs. 50% for Class II; 17.7% vs. 25% for Class III) and 32.8% 'undetermined' parental genes caused by allowing multi-mapping reads in bwa mem combined with low (~7x) F1 sequencing depth.

Multiple internal numerical and species-label contradictions between text and tables: BelcheriHV-1 coding density reported as 72.7% in text vs. 70.4% in Table 2 (and genomic sub-blocks summing to 142.5 kb vs. 149.9 kb total length); BelcheriHV-2 ORF count reported as 72 in text vs. 74 in Table 2; big defensin absence rate reported as 77% in Results vs. 88% in Discussion; Class III F1 absence rate reported as 19% in text vs. 17.7% in Table 3; Discussion line 188 misattributing the B. floridae parent-offspring cross to B. belcheri; Fig 8 caption citing Table 2 instead of Table 3.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Retrospective Nextclade clade assignments benefit from hindsight compared to unstable lineage definitions during real-time variant emergence, requiring comparison against historical Nextclade versions.
Low 95% posterior prediction interval coverage in high-sequencing countries (USA and UK) due to multinomial over-dispersion and time-varying fitness requires uncertainty calibration analysis.
Evaluation needed to be extended to lower-income countries with sparser/pulsed sequencing effort and to multi-country hierarchical/pooled multinomial logistic regression models.
Synthetic downsampling assumptions regarding recent-week backfill and guidance on minimum sample counts in low-prevalence settings required clarification.

ai_only_critical_catches: Missing cell entry in Table 1: the '30 Lead from date of estimation' column under 'Mean Absolute Error' for Brazil - GARW is completely blank.
Nextstrain clade nomenclature error in Methods line 191, which identifies the initial Omicron BA.1 reference strain as 'clade 21L' instead of 'clade 21K' (21L is BA.2).

Uncompiled BibTeX citation key in Discussion line 154 ('Susswein et al. susswein2023leveraging') and minor internal numerical discrepancies between Results and Discussion (0-day MLR MAE range 2.2-8.6% in text vs. 2.10-8.60% in Table 1; 30-day median sequence counts 173, 31, 44 in Results vs. 170, 30, 43 in Discussion).

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Ambiguity in how subsequent SARS-CoV-2 infections (re-infections or control group cross-over infections) during the 3-year follow-up period were handled.
Need for stratification of cancer incidence by specific anatomical cancer types and by COVID-19 clinical severity.
Unmeasured confounding by COVID-19 vaccination status and pandemic-era disruptions to routine cancer screening and healthcare utilization.
Need for Cox proportional hazards model fit diagnostics (concordance index, Schoenfeld residuals) and explicit definition of 'active patient in the past 12 months'.

ai_only_critical_catches: Pre-procedural diagnostic testing bias (reverse causation / ascertainment bias) in March-November 2020: patients undergoing endoscopies, biopsies, imaging, or surgeries for suspected malignancy were systematically required to take a pre-procedure SARS-CoV-2 test (mostly testing negative) and subsequently received a pathological cancer diagnosis shortly after the 30-day landmark.

Failure to account for the competing risk of death (16.9% 3-year mortality; 84,542 deaths) using Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard models, which explains why the apparent protective association is absent in ages 18-44 and monotonically increases in ages 75-99 (aHR = 0.63).

Severe internal arithmetic and sample-size contradictions: Abstract reports 88,590 COVID-19+ and 427,566 COVID-19- (summing to 516,156 != 499,396), contradicting Table 1 and Results (85,680 COVID-19+ and 413,716 COVID-19-); Table 1 COVID-19+ age group percentages (60.7% and 60.9%) sum to 121.6%; Table 1 mortality counts (69,520 + 14,890 = 84,410) do not sum to Total Mortality (84,542); Table 5 cancer events sum to 54,853 vs. 55,840 in Tables 2 and 3 (987 missing events).

Direct self-contradiction between Abstract/Discussion ('except in Asians') and Results/Table 4 ('reduction in new cancer diagnoses was similar between white, black, Asian, and Hispanic populations', where Asian aHR = 0.73 matches White aHR = 0.74).
human_anomaly_details: Reviewer #1 wrote only a single 88-word conversational paragraph ('Of course there are three possibilities--increase, decrease or no effect. This is an interesting correlational finding, and even when you pull the confounds out a 25% difference remains, which is large enough to justify publication, but it could just be a statistical fluke...').

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Confounding between partner decision noise (beta) and partner reward performance, choice predictability, and cognitive effort in a stationary bandit environment.

Ambiguity in whether learning style (imitation vs. reward learning) is a stable trait driving partner choice or a state adaptation to the chosen partner's noise level, and whether mixture weights vary dynamically over trials.
Need for posterior predictive checks reproducing behavioral learning curves and GLMM effects, as well as parameter recovery stratified by partner choice group.
Deviations from the OSF preregistration (pooling pilot and main datasets for exploratory analyses, power calculation details) required explicit disclosure.

ai_only_critical_catches: Non-independence in the GLMM specification: fitting three separate binary mixed-effects logistic regressions (logit P(choice = X), Y, Z) to mutually exclusive bandit arms on the same trials and pooling their fixed-effect slopes/SEs via inverse-variance weighting treats negatively correlated multinomial outcomes as independent and underestimates standard errors by ~sqrt(3).

Typographical error in the dependent variable definition of Equation (1) in Methods, which states 'coded as 1 if the partner's choice was X on trial t' instead of 'coded as 1 if the participant's choice was X on trial t'.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Severely underpowered sample size (N = 7 total; n = 3 vs. n = 4), inability to verify normality for Student's t-tests, and need for non-parametric Mann-Whitney U tests and effect size discussion.
Missing statistical comparisons for baseline characteristics in Table 1, where baseline BMI is significantly imbalanced between arms (p = 0.03).
Need for within-group paired longitudinal statistical comparisons across baseline, Day 5, and Day 9.
Lack of clinical justification for HOMA-IR as primary endpoint over a 4-day window, arbitrary glucose cutoff of 140 mg/dL, gut microbiome analysis, and unmeasured dietary protein intake.

ai_only_critical_catches: Mathematical impossibility of achieving a two-sided exact Mann-Whitney U p < 0.05 with n1 = 3 and n2 = 4 (minimum possible two-sided exact p = 2 / C(7,3) = 2/35 = 0.0571 > 0.05), proving that the significant non-parametric p-values added in revision (e.g., p = 0.03) are artifacts of an invalid asymptotic normal approximation without continuity correction.

The headline between-group difference in plasma D-serine (+0.24 vs. -0.32 nmol/mL, p = 0.03) was driven by a significant within-group dietary-washout decrease in the unblinded control group (p = 0.02 after restricting fermented foods) rather than a significant within-group increase in the risperidone group (p > 0.07).
Mislabeling of a per-protocol/complete-case analysis (n = 3 vs. n = 4 after excluding 1 post-randomization dropout from the 8 randomized participants) as an 'intention-to-treat' analysis.

Unit errors in the Abstract and Results reporting urinary D-serine/creatinine and D-alanine/creatinine ratio changes in 'nmol/mL' instead of 'mmol/g Cr', plus baseline HOMA-IR inclusion criterion violation (1.6 +/- 0.6 in controls despite required baseline HOMA-IR >= 1.6).

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Justification for thresholded step-function tumor diffusion D_T(u) ('go-or-grow') and whether high predicted efficacy against diffusive tumors is an artifact of density thresholding.
Motivation for the exhausted CAR T-cell compartment V_E(t), killing rate saturation D(x,t), and 20% solid-tumor parameter scaling, requiring global/local sensitivity analysis.
Justification for modeling intracavitary delivery as a uniform spherical shell of CAR T cells without explicit cavity fluid geometry and fitting to mean mouse BLI trajectories.

ai_only_critical_catches: Typographical error in the governing CAR T-cell PDE (Equation 3): the diffusion term is written as div(D_C grad u) (the Laplacian of tumor cell density u) instead of div(D_C grad v).

Mathematical error in the 3D spherical volume integral for exhausted CAR T cells (Equation 7): the spherical shell Jacobian is written as 4*pi*r dr (which has dimensions of area, cm^2) instead of 4*pi*r^2 dr.

100-fold discrepancy in the reported CAR T-cell diffusion coefficient D_C between the Parameter Estimation section (D_C = 1.38 cm^2/day) and the Materials and Methods murine fitting section (D_C = 0.0138 cm^2/day), plus dimensional inconsistency in the time-step formula dt = min(a dr / D_C, dr / 5).

Radius-vs.-diameter confusion (1 cm radius / 2 cm diameter mislabeled as 'detectable tumor radius reached 2 cm' in Fig 6 caption and Results line 214) and copy-paste error in Fig 4 caption labeling intracavitary delivery simulations as 'intratumoral'.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Sensitivity analysis should include sensory impairments (hearing and vision) and separate brain-related conditions (stroke, psychiatric disorders) from non-brain chronic conditions.

Imprecise estimates in the smaller African ancestry sample should be reported with exact HRs/95% CIs and framed as inconclusive due to limited statistical power and cross-ancestry PRS transferability rather than 'comparable trends'.

ai_only_critical_catches: Informative censoring / outcome ascertainment bias caused by excluding proxy respondents at every follow-up wave, which systematically drops HRS participants when they develop moderate-to-severe incident dementia and can no longer complete the self-respondent telephone cognitive battery.

Construction of the Alzheimer's polygenic score (pT = 0.01) without linkage disequilibrium (LD) pruning/clumping, resulting in a PGS-AD that fails to predict incident dementia even in the large European ancestry cohort (HR = 1.05, 95% CI: 0.95-1.16, p = 0.30).

Direct internal contradiction between the Abstract/Results (which report that PGS-AD was not associated with incident dementia, HR = 1.05) and the Conclusions section (which falsely claims that 'higher genetic risk for AD' was significantly associated with elevated dementia risk).

Outcome-dependent exclusion of N = 80 rapid progressors (who transitioned from normal cognition to dementia between biennial waves without an intermediate CIND wave) from the CIND risk set, plus truncated African ancestry rows in Table 2 and '2018 and 2010 wave' typos in Figs 1-2 captions.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Sensitivity of MCSM predictions to the single 33-exudate medium (where only 84 of 243 GSMMs grew) and need for benchmark validation on a known ground-truth trophic process.
Limitations of automated CarveMe reconstruction (overestimation of auxotrophies, missing secondary metabolism) and artificial thermodynamic loops in regular FVA vs. loopless FVA.
Combinatorial FVA assumption: FVA computes min/max flux bounds per reaction independently and does not guarantee that multiple secreted metabolites can be co-secreted in a single feasible flux state.

ai_only_critical_catches: Unbounded mass-balance violation in MCSM where any metabolite with a non-zero FVA secretion flux at 90% biomass optimality is converted into an unlimited uptake bound (1000 mmol/gDW/h) in the next iteration, combined with the ad-hoc manual injection of 31 organic phosphorus (carbon + phosphorus) compounds from CarveMe minimal_medium at Iteration 4 after root-exudate succession stalled at Iteration 3.

High rate of stoichiometric reconstruction failure: 152 of 395 high-quality MAGs (38.5%) failed the MEMOTE stoichiometric consistency check (score <= 90%) after CarveMe reconstruction and were discarded.

Application of parametric one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD to heavily right-skewed, combinatorially multiplied 5-node PMM path counts (ranging from 398 to 50,628 paths per GSMM) across a small subset of primary consumers without reporting exact group sample sizes (n_H, n_S, n_NA) or non-parametric robustness checks.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Need for an explicit mathematical model of plasmid competition to generalize the parameter regimes under which horizontal and vertical transmission advantages allow streamlined plasmids to displace wild-type AMR plasmids.
Investigation of the faint ~1 kb deletion band in ancestral R1 colony PCR to distinguish pre-existing in vivo deletion variants from in vitro PCR template-switching across IS1 repeats.

Verification that plasmid segregation loss is negligible over 8 days so vertical competition is not confounded by plasmid-free cells, and inclusion of a full-length R1 TcR control in the barrier invasion assay.

Contextualization with prior literature on satellite plasmids (Zhang et al., 2019) and plasmid acquisition cost (Ahmad et al., 2023), and replacing 'stealth/deleted plasmids' terminology with 'streamlined plasmids'.

ai_only_critical_catches: Mathematical discrepancy between the text description of the ODE model and the displayed ODE system (Methods lines 46-75): the text states that conjugation into a co-infected cell (N_WM) displaces the resident plasmid with probability 1/2 to preserve structural neutrality (citing Lipsitch et al. [59]), but the displayed equations for dN_W/dt, dN_M/dt, and dN_WM/dt omit all co-infection displacement terms (+/- 0.5*(1-k)*N_WM*lambda_i), violating structural neutrality in the printed equations (and omitting the definition of total cell density T = N_0 + N_W + N_M + N_WM).

Pseudoreplication in the exponential growth-rate statistical analysis (lm(growth_rate ~ strain * plasmid * rep_nb) with df = 518 and TukeyHSD), which treats 12 technical replicate wells on the same 96-well plate as independent error degrees of freedom rather than modeling the n = 3 independent biological cultures per strain as random effects.
